subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Wireless EV Charging
description: Learn Wireless EV Charging in one minute.

hook.text: Imagine pulling into a parking spot and your car starts charging—no plug, no cable, no effort.

buildup.text: Wireless charging uses magnetic resonance to transfer energy through an air gap to a pad under the car.

discovery.text: Efficiency is around 90–93%—close to wired charging, though a bit slower.

twist.text: Some cities are testing charging coils embedded in roads—EVs could charge while driving.

climax.text: BMW and Genesis already offer wireless charging pads for select models in some markets.

punchline.text: The future of charging might be not thinking about it.

quiz.question: How does wireless EV charging transfer energy?
